plain_english: Beyond prayer-grounds, strange-fruit-giver — victorious, unprecedented in story, Śiva the true wish-tree.
Since from the One container all is got through the self, from You — yet my own self does not join You, the highest, Her.
sanskrit_cite: sarvavastuni ca yaikanidhānāt svātmanas tvad akhilaṃ kila labhyam asya me punar asau nijā ātmā na tvam eva ghaṭase paramās tām

plain_english: The self, knowledge-action-formed consciousness-body, is in every way the Lord alone — but would there even be a body among all these things, or what else?
sanskrit_cite: jñānakarmamayacidvapur ātmā sarvathaiṣa parameśvara eva syād vapus tu nikhileṣu padārtheṣv eṣu nāma na bhavet kim utānyat

plain_english: By unequalled fruit, stealing pain — melt into His sight-natured form; may my going be His-formed.
sanskrit_cite: viṣamārtimuṣānena phalena tvaddṛgātmanā abhilīya pathā nātha mamāstu tvanmayī gatiḥ

plain_english: When will foot-thought-jewel-creeper-fruition, amazing the perfected, befall me, from You?
sanskrit_cite: bhavadamalacaraṇacintāratnalatālaṅkṛtā kadā siddhiḥ siddhajanamānasānāṃ vismayajananī ghaṭeta mama bhavataḥ

plain_english: When, Lord, shall I fully see Your pure face-orb, from which streams unprecedented nectar-flood, which drowns the whole world?
sanskrit_cite: karhi nātha vimalaṃ mukhabimbaṃ tāvakaṃ samavalokayitāsmi yatsravaty amṛtapūram apūrvaṃ yo nimajjayati viśvam aśeṣam

plain_english: Your form, risen at mere meditation — when, Lord, will it ever fill with supreme-nectar floods my far gaps named non-duality-liberation?
sanskrit_cite: dhyātamātramuditaṃ tava rūpaṃ karhi nātha paramāmṛtapūraiḥ pūrayet tvadavibhedavimokṣākhyātidūravivarāṇi sadā me

plain_english: By touch of Your peerless rasa, unroaming abandoned — not even now is my mind, Lord: when will it be? Let it be soon.
sanskrit_cite: tvadīyānuttararasāsaṅgasaṃtyaktacāpalam nādyāpi me mano nātha karhi syād astu śīghrataḥ

plain_english: Not dry-bitter things only — bring on all, always, gained by offering to You; let even opposites befall me.
sanskrit_cite: mā śuṣkakaṭukāny eva paraṃ sarvāṇi sarvadā tavopahṛtya labdhāni dvandvāny apy āpatantu me

plain_english: Lord, may Your pure rays come face to face, as long as body-mind-heat-dark is wiped out.
sanskrit_cite: nātha sāṃmukhyam āyāntu viśuddhās tava raśmayaḥ yāvat kāyamanastāpatamobhiḥ parilupyatām

plain_english: God, be gracious till my path-blockers, truth-stealing, sense-thieves are tamed.
sanskrit_cite: deva prasīda yāvan me tvanmārgaparipanthikāḥ paramārthamuṣo vaśyā bhūyāsur guṇataskarāḥ

plain_english: With Your devotion-nectar-essence fill my mind fast, Lord — till these are carried off, drowned: all sapless habits.
sanskrit_cite: tvad bhaktisudhāsārair mānasam āpūryatāṃ mamāśu vibho yāvad imā uhyantāṃ niḥśeṣāsāravāsanāḥ plutvā

plain_english: In liberation-state, where is devotion to You — how could it shine even for the mortal-natured? So set me, Unborn, on a fitting attainment-ground.
sanskrit_cite: mokṣadaśāyāṃ bhaktis tvayi kuta iva martyadharmiṇo 'pi na sā rājati tato 'nurūpām āropaya siddhibhūmikām aja mām

plain_english: Greedy for a siddhi-drop's gain, don't settle proud me — thin is liberation beside Your devotion-face's sprouting aṇimā-wings.
sanskrit_cite: siddhilavalābhalubdhaṃ mām avalepena mā vibho saṃsthāḥ kṣāmas tvadbhaktimukhe prollasadaṇimādipakṣato mokṣaḥ

plain_english: May the Lord be pleased with me, His slave — I ask only this, since the three-worlds Giver exceeds my sight.
sanskrit_cite: dāsasya me prasīdatu bhagavān etāvad eva nanu yāce dātā tribhuvananātho yasya na tanmādṛśāṃ dṛśo viṣayaḥ

plain_english: In mind full of Your body-mindfulness-nectar-rasa, may Your lotus-feet-pair bloom in mine, ever dripping honey, supramundane.
sanskrit_cite: tvadvapuḥsmṛtisudhārasapūrṇe mānase tava padāmbujayugmam māmake vikasad astu sadaiva prasravanmadhu kim apy atilokam

plain_english: I have a Lord, a father — Tryambaka — and a mother, Bhavānī; no second exists for me here — thus most-fulfilled may I roam.
sanskrit_cite: asti me prabhur asau janako 'tha tryambako 'tha jananī ca bhavānī na dvitīya iha ko 'pi mamāstīty eva nirvṛtatamo vicareyam
